concerns.text: The paired t-test criterion is stated as 'at α=0.05 to confirm the model is not performing random guessing.' A paired t-test of predictions vs. DFT ground truth tests whether the mean difference differs from zero; a GOOD model yields p>0.05 (no significant bias), while 'random guessing' is not what this test detects. As written, an implementer cannot know which outcome constitutes success. Restate the pass condition, e.g. 'the paired t-test reports no significant mean difference (p>0.05) between predictions and DFT values on the held-out set.'
